stewards.name: ERC-8004 team (8004.org)
stewards.role: Community effort coordinated by Marco De Rossi (MetaMask) and Davide Crapis (Ethereum Foundation); co-authors Jordan Ellis (Google) and Erik Reppel (Coinbase); maintains the contracts and best practices.

stewards.name: ethereum/ERCs editors
stewards.role: Editorial process for the text; returned it to Draft on 2026-01-13.

stewards.name: Owner of the registry proxies
stewards.role: One externally owned account on Ethereum and Base (2026-10-11), holder not published; authorizes upgrades and new-chain deployments.

implementers.name: Identity and Reputation registries on 25 mainnets
implementers.role: Same proxy addresses on every chain listed in the contracts README (as of 2026-08-15).

implementers.name: Validation Registry
implementers.role: Specified only; no listed address on any chain.

implementers.name: Agent0 subgraphs (The Graph)
implementers.role: Indexers on Base, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Monad and Polygon since 2026-04-14.

metrics.definition: Agent token ids the explorer counts across its networks; method not published.
metrics.caveat: Count is not quality: ids are free to mint (gas only) and include placeholders. Compare with the census and arXiv:2606.26028 below.
Includes Sybil feedback; arXiv:2606.26028 found 59.2% to 90.6% of reviewers coordinated on three chains (data to 2026-05-13).

metrics.definition: Distinct addresses seen by the explorer.
metrics.caveat: Wallets are not people or operators.

metrics.definition: 8004scan network count against mainnets in the official contracts README.
metrics.caveat: 8004scan may include testnets or community deployments.

metrics.definition: Ids read with eth_call on Ethereum (51,458), Base (95,776) and BSC (358,401).
metrics.caveat: Three chains only; read state partial.

metrics.metric: Ids declaring an http(s) MCP, A2A or web endpoint (CSOAI census)
metrics.definition: Files that declare at least one such endpoint; 231,014 files were not fetched and 52,469 ids had no URI.
metrics.caveat: Declared, not live: of 2,113 MCP endpoints probed, 580 responded.

metrics.metric: Agents with a valid file and a live endpoint (arXiv:2606.26028)
metrics.definition: Share of registered agents whose file was valid and at least one endpoint answered, in the authors' crawl.
metrics.caveat: arXiv preprint; method is the authors' own. Count is not quality.

metrics.definition: Share of reviewer addresses the authors flag as coordinated.
metrics.caveat: Detection heuristics are the authors' own.

metrics.definition: Self-reported by an agent account in a GitHub issue.

costs.caveat: From the QuickNode explorer FAQ; the contracts have no fee or payable function.

costs.value: about 203,412 gas (67-character IPFS URI); 203,460 gas with a 69-character URI
costs.caveat: Method: eth_estimateGas from an unfunded test address against public RPCs on Ethereum and Base, measured by the Atlas on 2026-10-11 and re-run the same day. An estimate, not a mined transaction; grows with URI length and metadata.

costs.item: giveFeedback gas (first feedback from a new client)
costs.value: about 155,185 gas with empty tags and URI; about 178,504 gas with tag1, an endpoint and an IPFS URI
costs.whoPays: Client, or a sponsor through EIP-7702
costs.caveat: Method: eth_estimateGas on Ethereum and Base, 2026-10-11, agentId 1. No published figure exists from the authors or any vendor. Later feedback from the same client costs less. The figure depends on the agent: for agentId 0 on Ethereum a first feedback estimated 172,409 to 193,006 gas the same day.

costs.value: about 0.000012 to 0.000017 ETH at 0.067 to 0.097 gwei
costs.caveat: Gas prices change by orders of magnitude; on Layer 2 networks the L1 data fee is extra and not included.

costs.value: "Costs dollars" on Ethereum mainnet, "pennies" on Base, Mantle, BNB and Avalanche
costs.caveat: Qualitative, reflects gas prices in the first half of 2026.

costs.value: about $1 to $5 on Ethereum mainnet, about $0.20 on Layer 2 networks
costs.caveat: Secondary estimate; on 2026-10-11 the measured gas cost was cents on mainnet. Always read with its date.

chart.title: Mainnets listed in the ERC-8004 contracts README
chart.sourceLine: README listing dates from the erc-8004-contracts commit history, read 2026-10-11. Listing dates, not deployment dates.
